method: Native UI automation with AX snapshots and screenshots inspected in the conversation; no event-to-presentation timing inferred from tool duration.
observations: Restarted bounded 50 Hz counter in existing disposable shell. CHARTR_RECHECK_INPUT_OK rendered before captures; counter visibly advanced from 00012 through 06730.

During three complete 30-second captures, repeated Tabs/Spaces keyboard switches and sidebar two-page up/down scrolling. Screenshot showed spaces 13-32 after downward scroll. PID 52063 remained alive before/after all captures.
Zoomed to larger window and restored original size; terminal output and sidebar rendered at both sizes.
Opened Current space native popup. Activated Finder menu, then cancelled it; popup disappeared. Reactivated Chartr and terminal printed CHARTR_AFTER_ACTIVATION_OK.
Minimized test window using native minimize button. AX Raise alone did not restore interactive input. Opening exact test bundle through Finder restored it; CHARTR_AFTER_RESTORE_OK rendered.
Cmd+H did not visibly hide this build; its application menu is empty. No app-hide coverage claimed. Minimization covers the selected visibility stop/resume scenario.
Closed native test window. PID 52063 remained alive; 3-second sample had all 533 main-thread samples in normal event-loop waiting, no Metal callback or drawable acquisition.

Opening bundle while process had no windows did not recreate one. Source inspection found no on_reopen registration in unchanged crates/chartr/src/main.rs; platform callback is optional. Recorded as existing app lifecycle gap, not fixed by this patch.
Stopped windowless owned PID 52063 and launched identical isolated bundle through Finder. New PID 72781 restored the shell and printed CHARTR_AFTER_RELAUNCH_OK.
Typed exit only in disposable shell. AX showed Reattach afterward.
limits: No subjective user confirmation on patched build
